Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: No comprehensive digital ID system. National population register exists but is mainly manual/paper-based. Digital Eswatini project plans to develop digital ID building block. World Bank (2025) identifies NPR as foundation for DPI but notes it needs digitalization.

Comments: World Bank (2025) identifies health as a target sector for digital ID integration and DPI. Digital Eswatini project plans connectivity of health institutions to internet. No current health data exchange integration evidenced.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: National Payment Switch exists but >90% of P2B payments still cash-based (World Bank 2025). Digital payment systems exist with varying functionality. Government has initiated digital payment adoption with limited scope. Not integrated into a national data exchange platform.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: Digital Government Implementation Roadmap development underway under World Bank-funded Digital Eswatini project. ToR published for roadmap consultant. Smart Africa data policy includes a 5-year roadmap component. Roadmap under development, not yet finalized.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Eswatini Digitalisation Strategy 2024-2028 (Government in Your Hand) exists and mentions data exchange/interoperability. UNDP DRA 2024 conducted. World Bank Digital Eswatini project (2025) includes interoperability as a component. Smart Africa data governance initiative supports national data policy development from 2025. Data exchange mentioned in broader digital strategy.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: No national interoperability/data exchange platform operational. UNDP DRA 2024 explicitly notes absence of a national Interoperability Framework as a major obstacle. Digital Eswatini Project (World Bank P508948, approved Sep 2025) will develop DPI building blocks including interoperable systems. Status = Planned under the Digital Eswatini project.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: UNDP DRA notes digital exclusion among elderly, people with disabilities, and rural populations. 95% 4G network coverage but only 58% internet usage. High data costs (3.47% of GNI per capita). Partial accessibility.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Data Protection Act 5 of 2022 enacted (effective 4 March 2022) - comprehensive law covering data controllers, processors, trans-border data flows. Eswatini Communications Commission enforces the Act. Trans-border transfers regulated for SADC and non-SADC countries. Strong legislation exists but enforcement remains inconsistent per UNDP DRA.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: No data exchange platform exists yet. UNDP DRA notes digital exclusion particularly in rural areas. Current digital services are centralized with no sub-national participation in any exchange platform.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Despite 95% 4G coverage, significant rural-urban gap in internet use and digital services. Public WiFi available but poor connectivity in schools. UNDP DRA scores connectivity at 2.3 (systematic stage). Partial rural coverage.
